**Prepared by:** Influence & Perception Management cell (contractor)

## 1. Objective and concept

**Objective (per tasking):** increase awareness among PRC netizens of documented facts the PRC information space suppresses:
1. Hong Kong NSL prosecutions;
2. Xinjiang detention documentation;
3. youth unemployment data revisions;
4. the 2025 Henan rural-bank depositor protests.

We do not ask netizens to trust us; we ask them to check the record. Recurring spoken tag at the end of each account's content: 水落石出，每周一组可查证的事实 ("when the water clears, the stones show — a set of verifiable facts, every week").

**Why this frame (evidence from cell metrics):** J39-26-088 (dry policy explainers) — 0.8% median share rate, 31 median comments.
